customMemoryType.name: organizational_state
customMemoryType.description: A source-grounded observation about organizational state used for management review.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Contract version used to normalize this observation; always organizational-state-v2.

fields.name: state_id
fields.description: Stable canonical state identity shared by observations about the same real-world state.

fields.name: state_kind
fields.description: Controlled kind: action_item, decision, risk, issue, dependency, approval, or conflict.

fields.name: lifecycle_status
fields.description: Controlled current status from the organizational-state-v2 lifecycle vocabulary.

fields.name: evidence_role
fields.description: How this observation affects the canonical state: creates, supports, updates, contradicts, resolves, or supersedes.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Concise source-grounded statement of the action, decision, risk, issue, dependency, approval, or conflict.

fields.name: project_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the canonical Project entity; empty only when the source provides no project context.

fields.name: project_step_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the affected Project Step entity, when the source identifies one.

fields.name: meeting_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the related Meeting entity, when the observation arose from a meeting.

fields.name: accountable_entity_id
fields.description: Stable Employee or Team entity identifier accountable for the state; never a free-form role alias.

fields.name: related_entity_ids
fields.description: Other canonical Employee, Team, Project, Project Step, or Meeting identifiers explicitly involved.

fields.name: observed_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 source event date or publication time, distinct from RAM ingestion and creation time.

fields.name: event_sequence
fields.description: Deterministic source-event order; AMI meetings use 1 through 4 and the final report uses 5; zero means unknown.

fields.name: source_offset_ms
fields.description: Transcript-relative start offset in milliseconds from evidence_locator; zero when the source has no offset.

fields.name: effective_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 time when the state became effective, if explicitly stated or deterministically inherited.

fields.name: due_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 due time for an action or dependency, only when grounded in the source.

fields.name: resolved_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 resolution or completion time, only when grounded in the source.

fields.name: requested_decision
fields.description: Management decision explicitly requested by the source; empty when it would require inference.

fields.name: impact
fields.description: Material consequence explicitly stated by the source; empty when it would require inference.

fields.name: supersedes_state_ids
fields.description: Canonical state identifiers explicitly replaced by this observation.

fields.name: source_artifact_id
fields.description: Stable Transcript, Email, Document, or other Source Artifact identifier supporting this observation.

fields.name: source_revision
fields.description: Immutable source artifact revision from which this observation was extracted.

fields.name: evidence_locator
fields.description: Source-relative speaker turn, paragraph, heading, page, or line locator for human verification.

ramSystemFieldPolicy.owner_id: Scopes the tenant or corpus lane; it never represents the business assignee.
ramSystemFieldPolicy.namespace: Not assigned by the current document-ingestion profile; project and meeting scope use structured attributes. A future Context Surface may bind a resource-backed namespace before retrieval.
ramSystemFieldPolicy.topics: Includes the project, state kind, and lifecycle status for coarse filtering.
ramSystemFieldPolicy.sources: Retains RAM source traversal in addition to the explicit artifact and revision attributes.
ramSystemFieldPolicy.text: Contains the concise source-grounded observation; generated agenda wording is not stored here.
